thread:
maya: quick design check - finalizing SDK error->exception mapping. proposal: 401/403 -> AuthError, 422 -> ValidationError, 429 -> RateLimitError, 5xx -> ServiceError (with a RetriableServiceError subclass). also need consistent request_id propagation for streaming resume. cc @raj @toni

raj: sounds good. couple implementation notes:
- include status_code on exception (e.status_code)
- include raw body when present (e.server_payload) for diagnostics
- for 5xx prefer a RetriableServiceError so retry helpers can check isinstance(err, Retriable)

toni: streaming gotcha: sometimes stream yields partial frames then final non-200 with JSON. SDK should raise StreamingFramedError that carries request_id, resume_token (if the server provides one), and last_chunk_text so callers can decide resume vs restart. keep it lightweight.

leo: logging convention suggestion: WARN when raising, structured fields: request_id, route, model, client_platform, retryable (bool), status. e.g.

  logger.warning("request failed", extra={
    "request_id": rid,
    "route": "/v1/chat/completions",
    "model": "redwood-compat-7b",
    "retryable": true,
    "status": 502
  })

also include request_id in exception.__str__ for quick traces.

sasha: language guidance:
- python: attrs on exceptions + use `raise from` when wrapping to preserve traceback
- go: typed error values and helpers IsRetryable(err) and RequestID(err)
- js/ts: Error subclass with code/status/requestId and preserve `cause`

raj: add tests: mapping table unit tests + an integration test that simulates a 503 during stream resume and asserts request-id is logged and returned on the error.

maya: for client-configured retries, default to retry on 5xx and 429 with exp backoff; do NOT retry on 401/403/422. add an opt-in aggressive_retry flag for infra teams to expand retriable codes.

toni: ack on aggressive_retry. also add a circuit-breaker opt so aggressive mode can be temporary.

leo: let's add a short docs snippet in the SDK repo: docs/error-handling.md with examples for logging, exception mapping, and streaming resume pattern.

sasha: pinging @raj for a quick review of the python PR. I can add streaming frame tests.

raj: will review EOD. i'll update go helpers with RequestID(err).
